# sherpa-metric-group

One row of 1 to 4 metrics, across every column of the layout grid.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-metric-group/sherpa-metric-group.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-metric-group/sherpa-metric-group.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-metric-group/sherpa-metric-group.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-metric-group/sherpa-metric-group.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-metric-group/sherpa-metric-group.example.json) |

## When to use it

For a page's metrics: one row of 1 to 4 `sherpa-metric`, across every column of `sherpa-layout-grid`. Add `data-sticky` to keep them at the top while the page scrolls; a later sticky group stacks under the one before.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-metric-group data-sticky><sherpa-metric data-label="Revenue" data-value="$1.2M" data-delta="+12.5%" data-trend="up"></sherpa-metric><sherpa-metric data-label="Orders" data-value="8,204" data-delta="-3%" data-trend="down"></sherpa-metric></sherpa-metric-group>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-sticky` | boolean |  | it sticks to the top of its scroll box while its grid shows; stuck, its metrics join |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| (default) | item | 1 to 4 [sherpa-metric](sherpa-metric.md) |

## populate()

`{ sticky? }`

Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.
